entries.text: Git daily loop: `git status`, `git add -p` (review hunks), `git commit -m "imperative summary"`, `git pull --rebase`, `git push`. Commit messages say what changed and why, under 72 chars on the first line.
Never commit secrets or generated files: .gitignore .env, venvs, target/, node_modules, __pycache__, *.sqlite3. If a key was committed, rotate it; history rewriting alone does not un-leak it.

Undo: `git restore file` (discard edits), `git restore --staged file` (unstage), `git commit --amend` (fix last message), `git revert SHA` (safe undo of a pushed commit), `git reset --hard` only when you mean it.

Branches: `git switch -c feature`, work, `git push -u origin feature`, open a pull request; `git switch main && git pull` before starting the next one. Resolve conflicts by editing the <<<< ==== >>>> markers then `git add`.
GitHub CLI: `gh repo create name --private`, `gh pr create --fill`, `gh pr view --web`, `gh run list`; private repos stay private - double-check before `gh repo edit --visibility`.
